input:

where: Windows 실습 게스트 · 관리자 Windows PowerShell
input:
$stamp = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'
$case = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE `
 ('Documents\book2-ch07-' + $stamp)
Test-Path -LiteralPath $case

where: Windows 실습 게스트 · 관리자 Windows PowerShell
input:
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $case
wevtutil epl Security "$case\Security.evtx" /ow:false
$LASTEXITCODE

where: Windows 실습 게스트 · 관리자 Windows PowerShell
input:
wevtutil epl System "$case\System.evtx" /ow:false
$LASTEXITCODE
wevtutil epl "$defLog" "$case\Defender.evtx" /ow:false
$LASTEXITCODE

where: Windows 실습 게스트 · 관리자 Windows PowerShell
input:
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $case -File |
 Format-Table Name,Length
Get-FileHash -LiteralPath "$case\Security.evtx",
 "$case\System.evtx",
 "$case\Defender.evtx" -Algorithm SHA256 |
 Format-List Path,Hash

where: Windows 실습 게스트 · 관리자 Windows PowerShell
input:
$saved = Join-Path $case 'Defender.evtx'
Get-WinEvent -Path $saved `
 -FilterXPath '*[System[EventRecordID=47]]' |
 Format-List TimeCreated,Id,RecordId,Message

where: Windows 실습 게스트 · 관리자 Windows PowerShell
Windows 실습 게스트 · 관리자 Windows PowerShell
input:
$xpath = '*[System[EventRecordID=47]]'
$event = Get-WinEvent -LogName $defLog -FilterXPath $xpath
$event.ToXml()
